title: Shallow ground-water quality in an agricultural area of the lower Coastal Plain of South Carolina, 1997
citation: Reuber, E.J., 2001, Shallow ground-water quality in an agricultural area of the lower Coastal Plain of South Carolina, 1997: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-2001-377, map scale 1:1,700,000.
notes:
Pages 1-19, all pdf_text (pages 4-5 absent from the packet). Thirty shallow monitoring wells in the surficial aquifer, lower Coastal Plain (agricultural land-use study area), drilled May-June 1997 with solid-stem augers; no core and only limited cuttings, so there are no lithologic logs. Table 2 (page 11) transcribed for land-surface elevation, well depth, screened interval and water depth; its field properties (water temperature, specific conductance, dissolved oxygen, pH) and the water-chemistry tables (major ions, nutrients, pesticides, QA/QC; pages 13-18) have no field in the schema and were not recorded. Elevations are 'above sea level', which page 6 defines as NGVD of 1929. The 15-digit USGS well numbers encode latitude/longitude but no location is printed as such, so no location was recorded. Methods references (laboratory and protocol reports) were skipped.
SUBSURFACE: per-well water-quality results (pages 13-18) and field properties (page 11) have no schema field; Figure 1 (page 8) locates the wells but only on a map; no unit tops or bases, contours or cross sections. Datum: NGVD of 1929 (vertical), NAD88 as printed for horizontal (page 6).
